text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Five minutes until the "Project L'Arc" meeting begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't sleep at all last night.
Imagining our future activities,
my excitement simply wouldn't subside—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Look at you, all wide-eyed and excited.
choice_data_list: Oh no, I'm hardly a young boy...
Oh no, I'm hardly a young girl...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, what kind of training
do you think Satake's gonna bring to the table, huh☆?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: My vote is on Gol-pippi getting thrown onto a sea bream fishing boat♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El thinks they're gonna hand out super-heavy ankle weights to everyone!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "50kg on each side. Rain or shine, you keep them on, and on race day, you finally take the weights off, yes!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And once the shackles come off, I'll shout it out!
"From here on out, I'm going all out!" ...!
choice_data_list: Is it some kind of manga?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Haha! It's pretty lively around here, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get right down to it.
Allow me to explain the training that will lead everyone
to victory in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared the handouts.
Take one and pass the rest back, please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I check the handouts
distributed by Mei Satake."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the contents were—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...We won't be changing the training menu from each Trainer's policy...?"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As a rule, I won't give instructions from my end.
Please follow the training menu set by your in-charge Trainer as usual.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What could this mean?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Judging from our history of narrow defeats so far... maybe we need... a change in order to win...?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Of course I'll change it!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
However, we will change two things.
The environment, and the support system.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
First, what I want to tell you all is this—
"Japanese Umamusume are strong enough to take on the world."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the past, our sports science and training methods
can now go toe-to-toe with the rest of the world.
And that's all thanks to your seniors.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Japanese Umamusume have won against international competitors even in the Japan Cup.
They can certainly hold their own, can't they?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
However, they haven't won the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
In that case, there is only one thing you must prepare for.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: It's about letting your body adjust to unfamiliar ground.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
So, will you make the preparations?
Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Understood♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Mei Satake's signal, dozens of large,
box-shaped machines are carried into the gymnasium.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: T-That's...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's the VR Umalator.
And this time, it's a machine dedicated to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe,
running custom-made software.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, this is where
you will be training!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
This VR Umalator is custom-made.
The training workload is designed to provide
direct physical feedback to your bodies.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ngaaah~~, it's so hard to ruuuuun!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Haha! Running in Japan alone makes it tough to build up an aptitude for overseas turf, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The ParisLongchamp Racecourse you will be taking on...
commonly known as Longchamp Racecourse,
has turf entirely different from major Japanese courses.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It makes full use of Europe's distinctive natural terrain.
Unlike Japan's "flat" tracks, the natural soil
makes it quite a struggle just to build up speed.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The elevation changes are extreme—nearly double that of Nakayama Racecourse.
And because of the steep slopes,
if you can't pace yourself, you'll sink fast in the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you practice on Japanese racetracks,
it's difficult to win "here."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...So you can run even when you need maximum power.
Let me give you some good training."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Heeh! This VR stuff sure is handy.
Cooking up the worst heavy track in an instant like that.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! This software, co-developed with the
Satono Group, is packed with the reasons
why Japanese Umamusume have suffered defeats.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I need all of you
to overcome this challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: In the 'L'Arc Representative Exhibition Match' that I arranged!
choice_data_list: Is the "L'Arc Representative Exchange Race" a tournament?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: That's right. The scale is huge! You'll be competing against Umamusume from overseas, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "We'll send this VR system to top Umamusume overseas as well, and bring them onto the very same stage!"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"It's a cross-national representative match in VR!
It'll definitely help you overcome your challenges!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...In other words, you want me to get experience on European turf
and learn how to handle tough opponents
at the same time."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, it only happens once every few months,
but I can see it clearly!
Your future, one year from now, when you've grown stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Well, sounds like you're pretty serious about it.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
I'm so serious about this, I'd bet my entire life on it.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: In addition, this year we are planning a short expedition to France and an intensive program for the trainers.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: And next year—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: The budget's gonna drop to zero!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
That's how tough it is~
to aim for the world stage, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What about financial aid from the academy?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Included! Even then, we're expecting it won't be enough!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just what kind of scale are we talking about here...?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, just how far will it go?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "That's just how high the wall is. Without continuous, dedicated support, you won't be able to reach it."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "...Which is precisely why we want to create a 'Supporter System.'"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I don't just want people all over Japan to dream;
I want them to be among those who help make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: The amount one person can save or a single organization can cover is negligible. But if all of Japan were to support it...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...It should give a push to the backs of all Umamusume who ever dreamed of being number one in the world.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Including us, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So, what should we do for that?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I'm glad you noticed!
I want you all to become stars!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Yeah. A star that everyone will want to cheer for.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The VR space 'Representative Exhibition Match' that I showed you earlier
is going to be streamed worldwide
across the internet.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: On top of that, we plan to hold 'StarS Match Races,' commonly known as 'SS Matches.' Naturally, after inviting the press, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to show the whole country there
that you are stars worth believing in."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...How long would that be?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"If we're gonna do this,
let's win over the trust of the entire nation."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this a 100% anticipated project...
that everyone will want to cheer for!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Understood!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Let's train right away!
Here we go! Sato-no!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting with them,
one Umamusume after another
entered the VR Umalator.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All to conquer Longchamp Racecourse.
And to claim victory in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And to keep Project L'Arc going!
Days of utilizing SS Matches and representative exhibition races to raise public expectations began."
